AutodidactAgent 的诚实定位

AutodidactAgent mainly implements episodic and procedural memory through solved cases and reusable skills. It is not a general-purpose user-profile memory system.

它更接近 Solved Case + Best Skill + Score + Provenance，而不是通用长期用户记忆。

短期记忆不是自动“变成”长期记忆。只有满足稳定性、复用价值、用户授权和低冲突风险的信息才应 Promotion；临时工具输出、未验证推断和敏感信息默认不晋升。

Context Compression 的触发机制

Token budget approaching threshold
Topic / task phase changes
Stable decision reached
Repeated transcript with low new information
Tool result is large but only a small evidence subset is needed
Long-running session checkpoint

可靠做法不是无限“摘要的摘要”，而是保留事件日志和关键 provenance，从可验证原始记录重新生成 compact view。

必背

I do not treat the transcript as the state. I maintain structured state and compress views while preserving provenance.

2026-09-28 · 验证边界

六层记忆是本手册 taxonomy。身份/权限来源于可信安全上下文；Memory 不授予权限。Append-only 不等于永久保留敏感内容；纠正、删除、保留期限和派生视图失效都需单独设计。

Cross-session Memory：跨会话记住的是受治理的状态 §7.X

“预算不能超过 5000”是否应该跨会话记住，先看 scope 与 durability：它可能只是当前任务约束，也可能是项目级硬约束或稳定用户偏好。Memory 的核心不是存储介质，而是 promotion、scope、provenance、conflict 和 retrieval policy。

FIG.7.X1 · CROSS-SESSION MEMORY GOVERNANCE

写入要晋升，读取要路由，冲突要保留 lineage

长历史摘要只是 Context View。真正 durable 的约束应有结构化 scope、provenance、validity 与 supersession。

WRITE 01

Candidate Extraction

从用户显式陈述、Tool observation 或模型推断中提取候选记忆，并先标记 source_kind。
WRITE 02

Scope + Durability Gate

判断 task / thread / project / user / tenant scope，以及 temporary / stable / expiring。只有真正 durable 的信息进入长期存储。
STORE

Durable Memory + Provenance

保存 value 之外，还保存 source、confidence、valid_from / valid_to、supersedes、sensitivity 和 owner。
READ

Memory Route + Filters

当前 Decision 先决定需要哪类 Memory，再做 scope、permission、validity、relevance 过滤；不是对所有历史做一次全局向量搜索。
CONFLICT

Authority + Supersession

explicit correction、scope specificity、source authority、valid time 与 confidence 一起决定当前有效值；newer 不自动等于更 authoritative。
核心原则

Write selectively. Read selectively. Expire explicitly. Correct with lineage.

FIG.7.X2 · SAME SENTENCE, DIFFERENT MEMORY LIFETIME

表达Scope落点何时失效

LONG CONTEXT ≠ DURABLE MEMORY

Lost in the Middle 说明长上下文存在位置敏感性，但跨会话真正需要的是 persisted state / memory lifecycle。如果信息根本没有被持久化，新 Thread 里就无从召回。

Enterprise Knowledge Context：企业知识是受治理的上下文 §7.K

企业知识基础设施的目标不是把更多文本塞进向量库，而是把组织概念、规则、流程、案例和实时事实变成可版本化、可授权、可追溯的 Agent Context。

Source → Organize → Process → Serve → Govern → Agent Context

SOURCE

owner · expiry · supersede · lineage · usage feedback

可解释、可验证、可授权的任务上下文

Agent 使用的是经过治理的 evidence，不是无来源文本堆积。
核心原则

Enterprise knowledge is governed context, not merely retrieved text.

Context Budget：压缩、卸载与 Prefix Cache §7.B

Context 快满时，不只是删掉 Token，还要保住决策依据与可信证据，并计算前缀复用的机会成本。比较两条不同的信息流。

FIG.7.B1 · TWO CONTEXT STRATEGIES

两条路径：压缩视图，还是卸载原始证据？

两者并不互斥；最重要的是把 Model-visible View 与 Authoritative Record 分开。

A · COMPACTION

改写 Active Context View

历史中抽取阶段结论、决策理由和未完成事项。
STEP 1

Conversation + Tool History

原始历史先保存到受控日志/快照。
STEP 2

Summarize + Validate Invariants

检查精确 ID、否定条件、约束和决策依据是否保留。
OUTPUT

Stable Prefix + Compact View

Token 占用降低；旧 conversation tail 的 cache 复用可能被重置。
B · OFFLOADING

外置大体积原始材料

Tool 输出、日志、文档不必每一轮都常驻 Prompt。
STEP 1

Large Tool Result / Artifact

保存原始输出与权限、版本、来源。
STEP 2

Artifact ID + Relevant Excerpt

只把指针与当下需要的证据送进 Context。
OUTPUT

Selective Re-read + Evidence

保留可追溯原始证据；未来读取需要额外 I/O 与 Token。
组合原则

Preserve decisions. Offload bulk. Stabilize prefix. Compact selectively.

FIG.7.B2 · CACHE BOUNDARY

摘要重写的是 Tail，不一定破坏前面的 Stable Prefix

BEFORE

压缩之前

[System + Tools] → [Turn 1 … 28] → [Turn 29]
AFTER

压缩之后

[System + Tools] → [New Summary] → [Turn 29]
LONGEST MATCHING PREFIX

稳定的 System / Tool Prefix 仍可能命中缓存；首次改变的位置之后，需要按新内容计算。最终是否命中取决于缓存断点、有效期、模型与服务商实现。

容易混淆

缓存命中降低 Prefill 计算，不代表缓存中的 Token 不再占用 Context Window。

FIG.7.B3 · DECISION AND MEASUREMENT

三问四招之后，检查是否真的更便宜、更可靠

01 · REUSE

未来还会用吗？

小而关键的状态固定保存；大证据按 ID 检索。
02 · EVIDENCE

决策依据还是流水账？

保留约束、否定条件、决策理由；卸载噪声。
03 · LAYOUT

稳定前缀还是动态尾部？

缓存真正稳定的部分；用户修正和授权变化必须更新。
EVALUATE

Task success + evidence fidelity + cached / uncached / write tokens + TTFT + total cost per successful task

来源边界：该图解释用户视频中的工程问题，并结合 Anthropic / OpenAI 官方 Context 和 Prompt Caching 文档校正缓存失效、价格、TTL 与 Compaction 表述。示意非性能实测；读写价格需按实际模型与服务商核算。

上下文预算：滑动窗口反例与请求准入 · §7.13.3 / §7.13.7

滑动窗口不天然保住旧历史的前缀缓存：[System][A][B][C] → [System][B][C][D] 的首次变化在 System 后。B/C 顺序没变，也不是旧请求从开头延伸的相同前缀。System 是否能复用仍受服务商规则约束；这不同于引擎内部的 sliding-window attention / KV eviction。

摘要、外部记忆召回和 Rerank 都应按首次变化位置判断缓存边界。动态证据 suffix 改变时，前面的稳定指令可能仍可复用。用实际 cache read、未缓存输入与任务质量评测，不按操作名称猜命中率。

请求前检查：assembled_input_tokens + reserved_output_tokens + safety_margin ≤ model_context_limit。assembled_input_tokens 包含实际发送的 system、tools、历史、检索结果和摘要；已有工具结果不要重复计数。按具体模型/API 检查思考 token、隐藏封装及独立输入/输出限制，有条件时调用 token counting 接口。

下一轮工具结果或用户输入需要预留有界容量，或在装配前截断/卸载。75%～80% 不是通用预警标准，更不应等到 100% 才兜底；应在发送前拒绝或重组超预算输入，并为压缩操作本身预留空间。

安全裁剪应保留当前目标、精确 ID、否定约束和证据指针，并遵守 provider 的消息配对规则；不要留下无配对 tool result 或删掉仍在使用的 tool call。无法安全装配时暂停、缩小任务或请用户选择，不静默丢关键约束。这里是本手册工程建议，具体协议要求需单独检查。

不要把 Token 减少等同于事实保留。Agent 必须保留约束、关键异常、实体身份及可重新打开的原始证据。

核心规则

Compression is not retrieval; neither is proof of correctness or authorization.

Headroom newsletter · Headroom limitations · ACM paper

保留与遗忘：过期、衰减、淘汰、删除不是一回事 · §7.14

只有写入和召回、没有保留策略的 Memory，会在几个月内变成噪声库：过时事实仍被召回、低价值片段挤占 Top-K、合规要求删除的内容还留在索引与摘要里。遗忘不是定期清理脚本，而是必须显式定义的保留策略。

机制改变什么事实是否仍成立典型实现
有效期到期valid_to 到期，默认退出召回否，时间上已不成立有效期字段 + 召回前过滤
重要度衰减排序权重下降是打分函数中的时间/使用因子
容量淘汰存储层级迁移，不改变有效性是hot → warm → cold → tombstone
删除记录本体被移除—合规删除，并失效派生视图、索引与缓存

前三者都是降低默认召回优先级或迁移存储层，不是删除。删除受法规、合同或用户请求约束，必须覆盖原始记录、向量索引、摘要、缓存以及备份策略声明的范围。把清理缓存说成删除，是最常见的合规缺陷。

有些记忆不该按“久未使用”衰减：用户显式约束、权限、安全与合规规则、财务法律口径。它们的生命周期由来源权威和有效期决定，只有两种合法的遗忘——显式更正（新版本 supersede 旧版本并保留 lineage）或有效期到期。权限尤其不能作为记忆存储，必须按请求向授权系统重新校验。

重要度也不能由写下记忆的模型自评：source_kind、scope、是否被决策引用、是否被确认有用、是否在有效期内，这些信号只影响排序，不提升 authority。一条被反复召回的高分推断仍然是推断，不能覆盖用户显式声明。

召回顺序是硬过滤在前、排序在后：scope/tenant/ACL → 有效期 → 状态（active/superseded/archived）→ 相关性·权威·新近度·显著度。过期或已被替代的记录默认不进入候选，只在“查历史”这类显式意图下按时间线返回。把新旧记忆一起交给模型自己判断，等于把冲突解决成本转移到推理阶段，而且不可审计。

淘汰的终点是 tombstone 而不是黑洞：被淘汰的记忆保留 ID、来源事件、失效原因和时间，使“当时为什么这样答”仍可复盘；但 tombstone 不能保留已被要求删除的内容本体。评测要双向——该忘的没有出现在召回里（stale-fact rate），不该忘的在压缩与淘汰后仍能召回（retention recall）。只看库变小了，不能说明策略正确。

Cross-session Memory: persist governed state, not raw utterances §7.X

Whether “budget must not exceed 5000” should survive across sessions depends first on scope and durability: it may be a current-task constraint, a durable project constraint, or a stable user preference. Memory architecture is about promotion, scope, provenance, conflict, and retrieval policy—not merely storage.

FIG.7.X1 · CROSS-SESSION MEMORY GOVERNANCE

Promote on write, route on read, preserve lineage on conflict

A long-history summary is only a Context View. Durable constraints need structured scope, provenance, validity, and supersession.

WRITE 01

Candidate Extraction

Extract candidate memories from explicit user statements, tool observations, or model inferences, and label source_kind first.
WRITE 02

Scope + Durability Gate

Resolve task, thread, project, user, or tenant scope plus temporary, stable, or expiring durability. Only truly durable information enters long-term storage.
STORE

Durable Memory + Provenance

Persist not only the value but also source, confidence, valid_from / valid_to, supersedes, sensitivity, and owner.
READ

Memory Route + Filters

The current decision determines which memory class is needed, followed by scope, permission, validity, and relevance filtering—not one global vector search over all history.
CONFLICT

Authority + Supersession

Explicit correction, scope specificity, source authority, valid time, and confidence determine the active value together; newer does not automatically mean more authoritative.
Core rule

Write selectively. Read selectively. Expire explicitly. Correct with lineage.

LONG CONTEXT ≠ DURABLE MEMORY

Lost in the Middle shows position sensitivity in long contexts, but cross-session continuity requires persisted state and a memory lifecycle. If information was never persisted, a new thread has nothing to recall.

Enterprise Knowledge Context: enterprise knowledge is governed context §7.K

Enterprise knowledge infrastructure is not about pushing more text into a vector store. It turns organizational concepts, rules, workflows, cases, and live facts into versioned, authorized, traceable agent context.

FIG.7.K1 · KNOWLEDGE CONTEXT LIFECYCLE

Source → Organize → Process → Serve → Govern → Agent Context

SOURCE

Documents · workflows · rules · cases · data

provenance · owner · raw version
ORGANIZE / PROCESS

classify · relate · index · structure

Do not vectorize everything. Preserve hierarchy, relationships, scope, and structured facts.
SERVE

RAG · API · Structured Query · File Search

Choose the serving path by data shape, freshness, permission, and failure semantics.
GOVERN

version · permission · validity · correction

owner · expiry · supersede · lineage · usage feedback
CONTEXT

Explainable, verifiable, authorized task context

The agent consumes governed evidence, not an untraceable pile of text.
Core rule

Enterprise knowledge is governed context, not merely retrieved text.

Context Budget: compaction, offloading, and prefix caching §7.B

When context fills up, the job is not merely deleting tokens: preserve decisions and trustworthy evidence while accounting for the opportunity cost of prefix reuse. Compare two information flows.

FIG.7.B1 · TWO CONTEXT STRATEGIES

Two paths: compact the view or offload the raw evidence?

These strategies are complementary. The critical distinction is between the model-visible view and the authoritative record.

A · COMPACTION

Rewrite the active context view

Extract outcomes, decisions, and unresolved items from earlier turns.
STEP 1

Conversation + Tool History

Preserve source history in a governed log or snapshot first.
STEP 2

Summarize + Validate Invariants

Check exact IDs, negations, constraints, and decision rationale for fidelity.
OUTPUT

Stable Prefix + Compact View

Fewer active tokens; cache reuse for the rewritten conversation tail may be lost.
B · OFFLOADING

Externalize bulky original material

Tool output, logs, and documents need not remain in every prompt.
STEP 1

Large Tool Result / Artifact

Persist the raw output with permissions, versions, and provenance.
STEP 2

Artifact ID + Relevant Excerpt

Return the pointer and only the evidence needed now.
OUTPUT

Selective Re-read + Evidence

Retain traceable evidence; future reads incur I/O and token costs.
Combined policy

Preserve decisions. Offload bulk. Stabilize prefix. Compact selectively.

FIG.7.B2 · CACHE BOUNDARY

The unchanged system/tool prefix may remain cacheable; tokens after the first change require new computation. Actual reuse depends on breakpoints, TTL, model, and provider implementation.

Common confusion

A cache hit lowers repeated prefill work; cached tokens still consume context-window capacity.

After the three questions and four tactics, measure the real outcome

Will it be reused?

Pin small decision-critical state; retrieve large evidence by ID.

Context budgets: sliding-window counterexample and request admission · §7.13.3 / §7.13.7

A sliding history window does not automatically preserve the old prefix cache: [System][A][B][C] to [System][B][C][D] first changes after System. Keeping B/C in order does not preserve an identical prefix from the beginning. System reuse still depends on provider rules; this differs from engine-level sliding-window attention or KV eviction.

For summaries, external-memory retrieval and reranking, judge reuse from the first changed position. Changing a dynamic evidence suffix can leave stable instructions reusable. Measure cache reads, uncached input and task quality instead of inferring hit rates from operation names.

Before a request, check assembled_input_tokens + reserved_output_tokens + safety_margin ≤ model_context_limit. Count the actual system prompt, tools, history, retrieval and summary in assembled input, without counting existing tool results twice. Check model/API rules for thinking tokens, hidden framing and separate input/output limits; use a token counting API when available.

Reserve bounded capacity for the next tool result or user input, or trim/offload before assembly. A 75–80% warning level is not universal, and waiting until 100% is unsafe. Reject or reassemble over-budget input before sending and reserve room for compaction itself.

Safe trimming preserves the goal, exact IDs, negations and evidence pointers while respecting provider message-pairing rules. Do not orphan tool results or remove tool calls still in use. If safe assembly fails, pause, narrow the task or ask the user instead of silently dropping critical constraints. This is handbook engineering guidance; inspect the specific protocol separately.

Retention and forgetting: expiry, decay, eviction and deletion are not the same action · §7.14

Memory with writes and retrieval but no retention policy turns into a noise store within months: stale facts are still retrieved, low-value fragments crowd the top-K, and content that must be deleted for compliance survives in indexes and summaries. Forgetting is not a periodic cleanup script; it is a retention policy that has to be stated explicitly.

MechanismWhat changesIs the fact still validTypical implementation
Retention expiryvalid_to passes, so it drops out of retrieval by defaultNo, no longer true in timeValidity fields plus a pre-retrieval filter
Salience decayRanking weight decreasesYesTime and usage factors inside the scoring function
Capacity evictionMoves storage tier without changing validityYeshot → warm → cold → tombstone
DeletionThe record itself is removed—Compliance deletion that also invalidates derived views, indexes and caches

The first three lower default retrieval priority or move storage tiers; none of them is deletion. Deletion is constrained by law, contract or a user request, and must reach the primary record, vector index, summaries, caches and whatever the backup policy claims. Calling a cache purge a deletion is the most common compliance defect.

Some memories must not decay from disuse: explicit user constraints, permissions, safety and compliance rules, financial and legal definitions. Their lifecycle follows source authority and validity, so they have only two legitimate forms of forgetting: an explicit correction that supersedes the old version while keeping lineage, or expiry. Permissions in particular cannot be stored as memory; they are re-checked against the authorization system per request.

Importance also cannot be self-assessed by the model that wrote the memory. Source kind, scope, whether a decision cited it, whether reuse was confirmed useful, and freshness only affect ranking; they never raise authority. A high-scoring inference that keeps getting retrieved is still an inference and cannot override an explicit user statement.

Retrieval order puts hard filters before ranking: scope/tenant/ACL, then validity, then status (active/superseded/archived), then relevance, authority, recency and salience. Expired or superseded records stay out of the candidate set by default and return only as a timeline under an explicit history intent. Handing old and new memories to the model to arbitrate moves conflict resolution into inference, where it cannot be audited.

Eviction ends at a tombstone, not a black hole: an evicted memory keeps its ID, source event, reason and timestamp so a past answer remains explainable, while the tombstone never retains content that had to be deleted. Evaluate both directions: what should be forgotten must not appear in retrieval (stale-fact rate), and what must be remembered has to survive compaction and eviction (retention recall). A smaller store alone proves nothing.
